purpose: Prospective narrow static trial; observed engineering controls are separate from missing human evaluation

scope.input: Explicit user-owned local Python source; no protected evaluation roots
scope.positive_and_negative_property: Existing exact-candidate bounded static contracts, including literal-in-call chmod mode
scope.named_mode_variable_assignment: NOT_SUPPORTED; retain UNKNOWN even if a human knows the integer
scope.other_syntax: Review lead or unresolved unless existing complete registered semantics establish the stated property

engineering_resource_policy.unknown_inventory_after_early_stop: Explicit incomplete inventory; unenumerated remainder is unknown, not zero

engineering_controls.source: Separate agent-designed neutral source fixtures; references never enter detector input
engineering_controls.status: ENGINEERING_ONLY; final release receipts determine exact output

requirements: freeze actual supported constructs and references before execution
preserve disagreements, failures, missing inputs and timeouts
keep labels outside CLI source and prompts
report repository tasks separately from synthetic controls
no FPR or accuracy without matching negative references

exploratory_comparison.formal_sample_size: requires future pilot variance and target precision

human_task_and_value_protocol.arm_B: Same workflow plus the frozen cv-agent report
human_task_and_value_protocol.allocation: Different reviewers for each task's arms, rotate allocation across different tasks; stratify complexity before results
human_task_and_value_protocol.quality_improves_but_time_increases: User decides task value from costs; no automatic benefit declaration

gate_decisions.PR0: Clean-install component is measurable; actual user failure and user-environment minimum task remain missing
gate_decisions.PR1: Engineering evidence/invariants only; actual independent human quality remains missing

stopping_rules: No new real model API or target-execution experiment in this recovery task
Do not enable R17 while PR2/PR3 are unmeasured
Do not change thresholds after seeing pilot results; create a new protocol version
Do not replace failed, timed-out, disputed or unsupported controls with convenient successes
Do not count candidates as independent repository samples
